title: Fixed Open Shoe and D Handle Jigsaw
description: One newly authored complete static handheld jigsaw appearance. A thick flat sole shoe has a genuine front-open central slot. A rooted rear support carries the chamfered motor case and front guide head above a single finite vertical blunt strip. A whole upper D-shaped grip has a real through hand aperture and a separate underside trigger, and a continuous small front U guard surrounds but does not seal the strip. Rear cap, plain side selector and short cable-entry stub finish the whole exterior. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, one prop and zero scenes. No saw teeth, workpiece, power circuit, reciprocation, cutting demonstration, protective function, installation or operating/safety claim. Newly authored geometry, not a resized power hacksaw or angle grinder.
